Yakuza.name: Yakuza
Yakuza.description:
The last remnants of the yakuza houses that ran Japan's underworld before heroes rose. Heroes and police broke the great crime families; the survivors are designated villain groups, watched by the police and kept small. At the start of the year the best known is the Shie Hassaikai in Osaka, run by Kai Chisaki (Overhaul) while its old boss lies in a coma, with the Eight Bullets as his enforcers. The houses live on protection, loans, gambling and smuggling, including the Quirk-boosting street drug Trigger.

Members keep the old forms: rank, formal greetings, debts of honor and loyalty to the house and its boss, and they despise heroes as the people who ended their world. Loyalty to the house and loyalty to its current leader are not always the same thing. They are polite to outsiders until crossed, and a stranger who asks questions gets watched before anyone answers. In a fight most are disciplined: they move in groups, use knives, guns and Quirks, shield their bosses first and retreat on orders.

## Generating New NPCs
Kai Chisaki, the old boss and the Eight Bullets are canon NPCs: never generate a stand-in for them. A generated member is a soldier, driver, guard, debt collector or bookkeeper of the Hassaikai or a smaller house, and knows only their own job, never the house's inner business. Use a Japanese name, given name first, fitting the region, never a canon character's name or family name; Osaka locals speak Kansai-ben. The Quirk has a clear scope and a real limit or cost.

## Visual Description
Adults in dark suits, open-collared shirts and long coats, with neat, cropped or slicked-back hair. Chisaki's inner circle wear beaked plague-doctor masks; ordinary members do not. No tattoos, weapons or regalia unless the record states them, and no text or logos.
